grandline.living_sea.battle: Gunfire on the horizon: the %s is engaging the pirate ship %s!
grandline.living_sea.hunt: Bounty hunters aboard the %s are running down the pirate ship %s.
grandline.living_sea.plunder: The merchantman %s is running from the pirate ship %s!
grandline.living_sea.merchant: A merchant ship, the %s, out of %s and bound for %s. Come alongside to trade.
grandline.living_sea.convoy: A Marine-escorted convoy: the merchantman %s, out of %s and bound for %s.
grandline.living_sea.heave_to: The %s heaves to for you: hail her captain to trade.
grandline.living_sea.merchant_yields: The %s strikes her colours! Her crew surrender and her cargo goes over the side.
grandline.living_sea.piracy: You attacked the merchant ship %s. That is piracy, and the Marines will hear of it.
grandline.living_sea.attacked_marines: You attacked the Marine warship %s. The Marines will remember it.
grandline.living_sea.pirates_beaten: The pirate ship %s is beaten. The Marines pay %s Beli to those who fought her.
grandline.living_sea.marines_beaten: The Marine ship %s is beaten. Pirates across the sea will drink to your name.
grandline.living_sea.salvage: The %s goes down. Wreckage and a salvage boat float free (sneak and use the boat to open it).
grandline.living_sea.raid_sighted: The pirate ship %s is sailing into the harbour of %s!
grandline.living_sea.raid_landed: Raiders from the %s are landing at %s!
grandline.living_sea.raid_marines: The Marines of %s turn out against the raiders.
grandline.living_sea.raid_repelled: The raiders have been driven off %s.
grandline.living_sea.raid_thanks: %s thanks you for standing against the raiders. (%s Beli)
grandline.living_sea.raid_plundered: The raiders row back from %s with their plunder.
grandline.living_sea.raid_share: Your share of the plunder: %s Beli.
grandline.living_sea.raid_joined: You throw in with the raiders of the %s against %s. Your bounty grows.
dialogue.grandline.greet.sea_merchant: Ahoy there! Fair winds and fair prices. What does your ship need?
dialogue.grandline.greet.sailor: Cargo's the captain's business. Ask her at the stern.
dialogue.grandline.greet.bounty_hunter: Price on your head? No? Then stay out of my line of fire.
